notes.title: No Limits ‘Sandbox Mode’ Now Available in Prison Tycoon: Under New Management™
notes.content:
[i]Prison Tycoon: Under New Management[/i]’s ‘Sandbox Mode’ is out now on Steam!

In this new mode, the chains are off and you have the power to construct the ultimate rehabilitative environment, free of financial restrictions. Featuring a new art style, expanded design tools and detailed control over facilities and staff, this mode builds upon the original game while keeping the management mechanics that fans love.

Players can build and refine their facilities without the boundaries of campaign mode’s funding restrictions – giving unlimited access to supplies, buildings, therapies and staff. Through this new free play mode, players are set up for success to help inmates reintegrate back into society.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40200422/d739edcd3face3f89c6b7817052aef8c213231be.gif[/img]

Key Features of [i]Prison Tycoon: Under New Management[/i]: 
[list]

[*]Five Distinct Environments: Select from tropical, tundra, taiga (boreal forest), swamp or desert biomes — each with its own environmental challenges

[*]Build From Your Own Blueprints: Design every room, path, checkpoint and cell block

[*]Assemble a Team of Experts: Evaluate and hire staff to fill 12 different roles to run and maintain your prison

[*]Secure and Protect: Maintain a secure facility using guards, cameras, watchtowers and checkpoints

[*]Rehabilitate and Release: Monitor prisoners and provide the support they need to be released – including VR therapy, zero gravity rooms, romantic visits and more
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40200422/e8bbbb11bb41e5ffb4e8ddafe97fb30003bc31e9.gif[/img]

[i]Prison Tycoon: Under New Management[/i] reboots the series with a different take on what it means to be a successful warden. With a focus on prisoner reformation over punishment, players must maintain a balance of services and security as they strive to run and grow their facility. Acting as wardens, they’ll need to secure funding from state agencies, manage the flow of resources, and keep staff and prisoners happy while providing proper care for their charges. Whether constructing a new cell block, or a VR therapy room, players must maximize their investments to build and operate their prison efficiently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40200422/c568eda3e659826ce9738e303c7e5d7c5aa4561a.png[/img]

Jump into [i]Prison Tycoon: Under New Management’s[/i] ‘Sandbox Mode’ now on Steam! Get the base game and the new mode all for just $19.99!


© 2022 Ziggurat Interactive, Inc. Prison Tycoon is a trademark of Ziggurat Interactive, Inc. in the United States and other countries.

notes.title: Prison Tycoon Maximizes Security in New DLC
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/bf331e0c000794fc7b56349ed97cb70be413da65.jpg[/img]

New DLC: Maximum Security Launches Today

Security is the top priority when working with dangerous inmates. To keep things locked down, we've worked with developer Abylight Studios to bring you a brand-new, content-filled DLC to the engaging Tycoon and Business-sim Prison Tycoon: Under New Management. Titled “Maximum Security,” this expansion extends your prison’s repertoire by adding new types of guards, new prisoners to select, and more. High risk equals high reward and the Maximum Security DLC rewards wardens who take on challenging charges.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1888890/

In the new Maximum Security DLC for Prison Tycoon: Under New Management, players are tasked with reforming a menacing new type of charge: the Maximum Security Prisoner. To cater to their new guests, wardens have many new tools at their disposal, from laser tracking cameras and high security towers to user-defined patrol paths for new guard types and much more. Can you rise to the challenge and remain steadfast in your goal of rehabilitation? 

‍
[h1]Key Features of the Maximum Security DLC Include: [/h1]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/4c9865c3a03ae6f8aefd4ff67fe67ae83333ea38.gif[/img]

[h1]En Garde!:[/h1]
This DLC includes new K9 units and robot guards, helping the player increase guard efficiency and keep overhead down. And yes, you can pet the dog!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/6e7260664995820759f9a3bc24abefe553c1e225.gif[/img]

[h1]New Kid on the (Cell) Block:[/h1]
‍New Maximum Security prisoners have a rough look, and they tend to have a complicated past that will require new therapy rooms. Aid in their rehabilitation by addressing their needs while keeping them secure from the general population.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/5361feac5a88828114d819ecff28facb8d981ea8.gif[/img]

[h1]New Inmates, New Therapies:[/h1]
‍New types of inmates come with new challenges to work through. Make use of new therapy types to keep your charges on the track to recovery.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/0cf118442f74ded3c75aafc5bb16dd95815a0914.gif[/img]

[h1]Built to Last:[/h1]
‍The new max security buildings are specially designed for the most dangerous prisoners. Players can build max security cells, max security isolation cells, therapy rooms, and other standard rooms in this new building.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/30bfd574693e1ca00f5cd5b8274ae6979bed88ab.gif[/img]

[h1]Robot Guards Loading...:[/h1]
‍Have you ever thought "gee, I wish my guards were just a little bit better?" Well, now there are robot guards to populate your prison. They're more efficient than traditional guards and they are robots!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/882e1fe11d3ce88afadeb9d39792ccb63418cb5d.gif[/img]

[h1]They See Me Patrolling:[/h1]
Guards and K9 units can now follow user-defined patrol paths. You define the path, they patrol the route, and together your prison becomes safer. Stay vigilant.

[h1]Wishlist Maximum Security DLC today:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1888890/

notes.title: Prison Tycoon: Under New Management leaves Early Access
notes.content:
Prison Tycoon has improved greatly thanks to player feedback during the Early Access period. In addition to helping balance and smooth out original mechanics and functionality, this period has seen many new features added to the game.

Upgrades include:
-Prisoner fights
-Visitation rooms including conjugal visits ;)
-Room cloning tool added by popular demand
-Climatization system/mechanic added. Players must keep prisoners and staff at a comfortable temperature.
-Multiple prisoners can arrive at the same time, increasing difficulty
-Mechanic rebalances
Maintenance fixed so things stay visibly clean longer
Prisoner happiness
Worker proficiency


Now as we leave Early Access, we will be adding more features with the addition of a FREE DLC package called Roll Call. This DLC adds exciting personalization features for players including a new character creation tool allowing players to rename and customize the look of their prisoners and staff. This also introduces new Twitch integrations for streamers that they and their viewers are sure to enjoy.

Check out the New DLC [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825450/Prison_Tycoon_Under_New_Management__Roll_Call/]HERE![/url]

notes.title: Early Access Dev Diary #2
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=mPGa9aoktOk;full][/previewyoutube]


Today we wanted to test what would happen if we removed all the doors. I know we said that our prison will be a different kind of prison, but it won’t go as far as to have a full open door policy (I think). The point of this experiment was to see what would happen to the speed and flow of the game.

Doors are… complicated, and ours behaved like doors should, with the full arc of movement and the actors interacting with them with the proper animation. It looked good, but after a while, we felt that it was slowing down the pace of the game, and even creating queues in front of some rooms from time to time.

The experiment was good! The game felt faster, with a better flow. We will be turning the doors into sliding doors, like in Star Trek Tongue, in future builds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40200422/9a44ed160e2d472599c49a23c0750c0b4b419e52.gif[/img]

We’ve been putting a lot of care and thought into the usability and how the game feels. From the UI, to the flow of the construction process, the music, the sounds, the animations… Our main goal is to make it pleasant for the players and also to make it easy for them to understand what’s happening in the game at any moment. Tycoon games can be very dense, so these are very important goals for us and something we keep in mind at all times during development.

One of the things we are noticing during these playing sessions is that we reach high prestige levels too fast. This is something we will have to balance in the future.

Prestige levels reward the players for expanding their prison and keeping it well equipped, unlocking new items and rooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40200422/cfcc3d3f88f51a5672e8feca3c62f32ee75e6955.jpg[/img]

Choosing the best candidates for your staff is key to keep a well-managed prison. You’ll need to find a balance between efficiency and cost (but also, there are people that just look cool).

Of course, you can reward your best-performing employees with a promotion, which will increase their efficiency (and their salary).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40200422/86d6dbb88897356cf4e505cb494b034e38eed768.jpg[/img]

You’ll be able to manage their schedule too, changing how much are they allowed to rest and when among other things.

Right now we have to balance the speed at which they recover stamina because they have to spend too much time in the staff room.

That's all for today! Not big bugs to report, just small things to fix and tweak 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40200422/6539457f551a41f56c102cdb39ad55ee600ac0a7.gif[/img]

notes.title: The Road to Early Access Launch Day Dev Diary
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=mPGa9aoktOk;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi! Launch day has come

The game already feels quite stable for an Early Acces release, and today we allowed ourselves to relax for a while and have a bit of fun.

One of our players suggested throwing a party in prison and… sure! Why not?

We mentioned before that Prison Tycoon: Under New Management won’t be like an average prison. This new management believes in rehabilitation and we have some creative ideas on how to achieve it.

Our prison, our rules. Like in any good tycoon game, we have the freedom to experiment and run the business the way we think it’s best. So, if we want to party… who’s going to stop us?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40200422/12d3e0caf9be1e2c124b4285f433b436059b656f.gif[/img]

Dance rooms are one of the tools in this new management’s repertoire. They are specially useful for rehabilitating hackers. You know… there’s a whole world of activities beyond our computers Smiley

Each inmate will be in prison for a different reason and some therapies will be more effective than others. As a warden, you’ll have to adapt your prison to the prisoners that inhabit it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40200422/a2205fa427e49a50a467b95ea9ae243e0df952cb.gif[/img]

There's no good party without a wide variety of snacks and drinks! You’ll want to keep your inmates well fed and happy, otherwise they might try to escape or fight with other prisoners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40200422/98db7ea1e08d69c545fbdf97822e227a28e2d033.jpg[/img]

And what about videogames? Playing good ol’ arcades like Cursed Castilla or Super Hydorah will surely put anyone on the right path!

All the music and the party lights will require a lot of power. As always, we must make sure that everything is connected to the power grid, and manage our resources well if we want to keep expanding (nothing will stop this party!)

It was a great party, and deserved after a lot of hard work by our dev and QA teams... and the results keep showing every day, with more polished builds. Still things to fix, balance and tweak, but we are getting there! Smiley
